leads.name: Cypresses at the Franciscan monastery, Živogošće (register ps.4490)
leads.species: Cypress (probably Cupressus sempervirens, not stated by the register)
leads.reason: Bioportal point row, protected 1970-03-01, register name says 'čempresi' (a group). No fetched source describes the trees, their age or count; the monastery of the Holy Cross (17th century) is a working Franciscan house and no source says its grounds are open. Fails ensemble and access bars; needs a session for a photo or a visit report.

leads.reason: Bioportal point row, protected 1970-03-01, a group in a cemetery (open ground would be fine). No source beyond the register describes the trees, how many or how old; a search found no page on them. Not a single collectible point unless a source names one standout trunk.

leads.name: Garagnin-Fanfogna garden, Trogir
leads.reason: A historic botanical garden (late 18th to early 19th century, 'oldest botanical garden in Croatia' per a 2005 Šumarski list article by Gregurević, seen in a search summary only). No individual old tree named in any source seen in the 10-minute search; a walk-through garden is not a tree. The Šumarski list 2005 article (sumari.hr/sumlist/pdf/200504150.pdf) may name specimens; not fetched.

leads.reason: Timeout article 'In Šibenik beautiful wild chestnut trees return home' (2020-03-14) seen in a search listing only, not fetched. Probably replanted trees, not old; not examined.

blocked.name: Bishop's pine and old oak of Soline, Brela (Makarska riviera)
blocked.reason: Both originals are gone: Bijanković's pine lost in 1983 (replacement planted), old downy oak of Soline (natural monument 1967) toppled by a storm in 2012 and replaced by a sapling planted 2019 (brela.hr/en/nature/in-memory-of-giants). A replacement sapling is not an ancient tree; known dead, never ships. Replacement sapling in the courtyard of Our Lady of Mount Carmel, Brela, could be noted for a future walk, not a tree page.
